title: Περὶ εἱμαρμένης — Alexander of Aphrodisias, On Fate (De fato); RU «О судьбе»
author: Alexander of Aphrodisias
date: c. 198–209 CE (dedicated to Severus and Caracalla)
edition: Bruns, Supplementum Aristotelicum II.2 (1892), public domain: https://archive.org/details/alexandriaphrodi00alex.
ru_evidence: ruwiki Александр Афродисийский lists only Russian 'О смешении и росте' (Solopova 2002). CyberLeninka ('Александр Афродисийский О судьбе перевод') returns studies only.
en_evidence: R. W. Sharples, Alexander of Aphrodisias on Fate (Duckworth 1983; reprinted), per Open Library.
other_translations: French: Thillet, Budé (1984), not verified in this sweep. Others: unknown.
value: The classic Peripatetic refutation of Stoic fate. Central for the history of free will, responsibility and compatibilism; short and widely taught in philosophy curricula.
ai_feasibility: High. Clear argumentative prose with established terminology; short.
